messages:
maria (sec): Incoming engagement: external pentest booked Wed 09:00-13:00 PT. Need a short plan for ephemeral access, KMS-mediated evidence reads, and a retest SLA. Who volunteers to run the access table?
ajay: I'll take ownership. High-level: ephemeral assessor roles, bucket read-only, KMS decrypt via proxy, audit stream to security account, and mapping to tickets.
lina (compliance): Please ensure we capture consent and data classification labels before any evidence is shared. We'll need an evidence retention label on the S3 objects.
kevin (infra): Suggestion: use AWS STS with AssumeRoleWithSAML or OIDC (assessor IdP). But keep session_max_duration=3600 and tighten the role policy. KMS: create a key with an Inline grant to kms-proxy role only. No direct principals for assessors.
donna (sre): Oncall: I can cover the start and can pause traffic if tests look noisy. Need a rollback playbook in case failover scripts are hit.
sec-bot: [auto] intake: SOW, assessor roster, evidence-bucket created (s3://pen-evidence-2026), access matrix draft: pending.
ajay: Draft role policy summary: { "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::pen-evidence-2026","arn:aws:s3:::pen-evidence-2026/*"]}, {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["s3:PutObject","ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute","iam:*"],"Resource":"*"} ] }
(we'll store as Terraform but posting inline for review)
kevin (infra): KMS proxy flow: service role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/kms-proxy will be allowed in key policy. Assessors assume pen-assessor role that can call kms:GenerateDataKey via the proxy only. Example CLI verify: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pen-assessor --role-session-name dryrun --duration-seconds 3600` then `aws s3 cp s3://pen-evidence-2026/readme.txt -` using temporary creds.
lina (compliance): Also require object tags: classification=restricted, evidence-id=<ticket-id>. We'll include a pre-upload step: presigned PUT URLs will enforce tagging.
ajay: I'll add columns to the remediation board: id, title, severity, owner, evidence_path, presigned_url, retest_target. New tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PEN-2026 (internal).
sam (pm): Product freeze: we'll block non-emergency infra and config deploys in the test window. Emergency deploys: must go through triage and sign-off from @maria and @donna.
donna (sre): Retest policy: low/medium -> next available slot in two weeks; high/critical -> expedited retest within 72 hours. We can allocate a mid-week slot if owners can patch quickly.
ajay: Operational prep checklist (short): 1) create pen-assessor role w/ 1h TTL 2) provision presigned S3 readroom for artifacts 3) enable CloudTrail data events + push to audit account 4) KMS key policy to proxy only 5) run dry-run assume-role + s3 get.
kevin (infra): Dry-run commands I'll run: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pen-assessor --role-session-name smoke --duration-seconds 3600` then `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=... AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=... aws s3api get-object --bucket pen-evidence-2026 --key readroom/index.html read.html` and `aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/pen-evidence-key` to confirm key policy.
maria (sec): Can @ajay and @kevin do a dry-run tomorrow 15:00 PT and paste the command outputs here? I want to capture the smoke logs in the runbook.
ajay: I'll do the assume-role and presigned URL smoke test and drop the curl output.
kevin (infra): I'll validate KMS grants and CloudTrail delivery.
sec-bot: [auto] dry-run scheduled 1771238000 (tomorrow 15:00 PT). Reminder set for 30m prior.
lina (compliance): Please ensure the evidence bucket lifecycle policy removes assessor uploads after 90 days unless ticket escalated. Add retention flag to tracker.
ajay: Added retention & tagging rules to PEN-2026 under 'evidence-policy'.
donna (sre): If the assessors start hitting production interfaces aggressively, we default to rate-limit and pause the test. Escalation path: incident channel -> oncall -> infra lead.
maria (sec): One more ask: label all assume-role CloudTrail events with the assessor-id in session tags so we can map to uploads. Can we add `sts:TagSession` tags?
kevin (infra): Yes, we can require TagSession during assume-role and use condition in trust policy: `StringEquals: {"sts:TagSession":"true" }` and parse tags. We'll include example.
ajay: ack. I'll update the Terraform and attach the snippet to the ticket.
maria (sec): Please one-line ack if you can make the dry-run and own the task you volunteered.
ajay: ack (will run smoke tests).
kevin (infra): ack (will validate KMS & cloudtrail).
donna (sre): ack (oncall + rollback corridor).
lina (compliance): ack (retention + tagging signoff).
sam (pm): ack (product freeze coordination).
maria (sec): thanks team. I'll publish the runbook after we collect the smoke logs and then close intake.
